title: The first trees
logline: Past the bend. The first trees of the ridge proper, December, the trunks close, the road become a path, the glow ahead a warmth between them like a room with a light on. A man's back and a dog, small.

panels.composition: Past the road's bend: the trunks of the first big cedars, close, the gravel become a needle path, and ahead between the trunks a warmth like a lit room seen from a dark yard. A man from behind and a small three-legged dog, small at the path's start.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a needle path entering close cedar trunks in December with a warm glow between the trees ahead like a lit room seen from outside, a man seen from behind and a small three-legged dog small at the path's start, no words

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards

notes: Past the bend. A lit room seen from a dark yard.
